reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar = param.replace("\"", """) written to HTML attribute data-name. Although double quotes are escaped, the encoding is insufficient for XSS prevention as it does not escape angle brackets (<>) or ampersands (&), allowing attackers to bypass via payloads like \'"><script>alert(1)</script><\'. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.
